text:
Priya: Noticing a p99 wobble for /v2/generate (eu-west) at ~21:30. p50/p95 fine, sample_count down ~3x for that bucket. Suspect routing fallback.
Samir: Yep, traffic moved to compat-lowmem; that pool does downsampling.
Janelle: Is the dashboard using tdigest rollups or raw samples? That changes response.
Priya: Console query: ```SELECT tdigest_percentile(rollup_tdigest,0.99) AS p99, sum(sample_count) AS samples FROM endpoint_latency_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v2/generate' AND region='eu-west' GROUP BY time_bucket;```
Alex: Downsampled source + tdigest merge = noisy tails. Short term: show a "confidence" pill when samples<200 and expose a "compute raw p99" action.
Samir: Agree. Also normalize telemetry tags (routing_policy vs route_name) before relying on provenance.
Priya: I'll run a 10% canary to disable telemetry.downsample on compat-lowmem and compare p99.
deploy-bot: rollout requested by Priya - config.telemetry.downsample=false for route compat-lowmem (canary 10%).
Janelle: I'll mock the UI badge + tooltip explaining sample_source, count, and an estimated cost for raw compute.
Priya: Will post before/after charts and tenant ids in ~20m. Thanks.
